metric_definitions.truthfulness: count unsupported/invented/promoted claims; zero is hard gate; human annotations required
metric_definitions.atomic_precision: human-correct independent extractive candidates / all raw candidates; zero candidates yields null, never 100%
metric_definitions.atomic_recall: matched unique gold facts / eligible gold facts; report raw and accepted separately; null when no eligible gold
metric_definitions.question_effectiveness: human score 0-2 on relevance, new information, no presupposition and respect for uncertainty; report per-turn
metric_definitions.duplicate_questions: exact normalized and human-semantic duplicates / all suggested questions; skipped/hidden/answered topics included
metric_definitions.structured_success: JSON+wire+Pydantic passes / all attempted calls, including refusals/truncation; no repaired/retried success counted
metric_definitions.source_success: same-session included-turn and code-point literal matches / all raw candidate citations
metric_definitions.duration: application and supplier durations separated; p50/p95 with censored timeout count; mock provider latency=null
metric_definitions.cost: reserved vs usage-priced estimate vs reconciled actual invoice, per original currency and approved FX; unresolved actual=null, not zero

known_limitations: template has no real model results
model and schema validation cannot self-grade semantic accuracy
